title: El migrante
goal: Say goodbye to somebody leaving for good
culture: The bus goes to the border and after that nobody at this terminal knows anything. Everybody has somebody on one of these. Nobody says how long, because nobody knows, and the honest no sé is allowed to sit there without being filled in.

beats.es: Me voy, pues. Ya está el bus ahí.
beats.good: Se va — he is going. That bus goes to the border, and after the border nobody standing here knows anything.

beats.es: Hoy mismo. A las tres sale.
beats.objective: Ask when he is coming back
beats.en: And when will you be back?
beats.good: Ask it. Everybody standing at that gate is thinking it and somebody has to be the one who says it out loud.

beats.es: No sé. De verdad no sé, hermano.
beats.good: No sé is the honest answer and the temptation is to fill the silence after it with something hopeful. Do not. Letting it stand is the respect.

beats.es: Cuídese usted, pues. Cuide la casa.
beats.objective: Say the thing there is to say
beats.good: Said to people leaving whether anybody believes it or not, because it is what there is and nothing smaller would do.
